# Image Lifecycle Gap and Implementation

## Discovered gap
Existing unit tests separately prove stable asset identity, new transport bytes, and preview cache invalidation. No existing browser test proved the complete visible lifecycle in one continuous user flow.

## Added witness
`tests/image-lifecycle-smoke.cjs` now exercises the real app runtime:
- visible reference mode;
- visible Add Image file input;
- stable assigned asset ID;
- preview URL capture;
- real GenerationTransport build;
- visible Replace with a second local image;
- same ID + changed preview + changed outgoing data URL + changed signature;
- visible Remove + empty outgoing image payload;
- reload + durable replacement record under the same IndexedDB asset ID;
- zero console/network failures.

The unsent draft itself is intentionally in-memory and is not falsely asserted to survive reload. The reusable asset replacement is the durable contract.

NEXT_ACTION: generate two valid 512x512 PNG fixtures outside the repo and run this browser witness against the local current-main app.
